newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israeli warplanes rocket eastern Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli warplanes rocket eastern Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli warplanes rocketed on Tuesday suspected Hizbollah targets in the eastern Bekaa Valley shortly after guerrillas attacked a pro-Israeli outpost, security sources said.
There was no immediate word on casualties in the air attack -- the 48th into Lebanon since the beginning of the year.
The sources said four warplanes fired a total of eight rockets into the hills of Libbaya-Yohmour in the southeastern part of the Bekaa, north of Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone.
Earlier, Hizbollah guerrillas fired mortar bombs into the South Lebanon Army outpost of Ahmadiyyeh in the eastern sector of the zone, facing the hills, lightly wounding a pro-Israeli militiaman.
On Monday, Israeli commandos in helicopters backed by warplanes raided suspected Hizbollah targets in southern Lebanon, triggering fierce clashes at Kfour in Nabatiyeh outside the zone.
Five Hizbollah guerrillas were killed later by three roadside bombs planted by the Israeli commandos.
Hizbollah is fighting Israeli troops and their local militia allies in a bid to oust them from the 15-km (nine miles)-wide south Lebanon occupation zone.
